page.notes: The running head is a heavy black-letter-like decorated title and could not be read; it is left as illegible. The printed hyphens at line ends (pen-sionis, obligatio-nem, deberen-tur, SV-PRASCRIPTA, Infi-ticia, in-siti) are kept as printed. Words broken without a printed hyphen (uerbis, reddere) are written whole. The spelling uidebatur, ui, and similar are normalised to u/v and i/j rules as instructed; the printed ufurarum, ufurae are kept as printed letters apart from the u/v correction. The run-in italic headings are part of their paragraphs, not marginal notes.
